description: This file defines the main API application for a notes management backend, utilizing FastAPI. It includes endpoint definitions for CRUD operations on notes, startup/shutdown event handlers for database connection management, CORS middleware configuration, and helper functions for object ID handling. The file orchestrates the interaction between the API routes and the MongoDB database via dependency injection and shared resources.

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: A simple endpoint to check the health status of the service.

methods.name: List[NoteOut] list_notes(collection: AsyncIOMotorCollection = Depends(get_notes_collection))
methods.description: Retrieve all notes from the database, ordered by latest update.

methods.name: NoteOut create_note( payload: NoteIn = Body(..., description="Note data."), collection: AsyncIOMotorCollection = Depends(get_notes_collection), )
methods.description: Create a new note with server-generated timestamps.

methods.name: ObjectId _parse_object_id(id_str: str)
methods.description: Convert a string to a BSON ObjectId, raising HTTP 400 if invalid.

methods.name: NoteOut get_note( id: str = Path(..., description="Note id (ObjectId string)"), collection: AsyncIOMotorCollection = Depends(get_notes_collection), )
methods.description: Retrieve a single note by its ObjectId.

methods.name: NoteOut update_note_partial( id: str = Path(..., description="Note id (ObjectId string)"), payload: NoteUpdate = Body(..., description="Fields to update."), collection: AsyncIOMotorCollection = Depends(get_notes_collection), )
methods.description: Partially update an existing note's fields.

methods.name: NoteOut update_note_replace( id: str = Path(..., description="Note id (ObjectId string)"), payload: NoteIn = Body(..., description="Full note payload to replace current values."), collection: AsyncIOMotorCollection = Depends(get_notes_collection), )
methods.description: Replace an existing note's title and content entirely.

methods.name: JSONResponse delete_note( id: str = Path(..., description="Note id (ObjectId string)"), collection: AsyncIOMotorCollection = Depends(get_notes_collection), )
methods.description: Delete a note by its ObjectId.
